CAUSE OF FIRE IN DPWH OFFICE

WATCH: Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon says a short circuit caused the fire in the agency's Bureau and Research Standards building in Quezon City, not a computer unit that exploded as previously reported. | @bylancemejico https://t.co/WaoltSx0Ul

MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) is investigating the cause of the fire that hit the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 4B Mimaropa office in Quezon City, including the possibility that it was deliberately set, NBI Director Jaime Santiago said on Thursday.

data.text:
IMBESTIGASYON SA SUNOG SA DPWH BUILDING 

Pinabulaanan ni Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Sec. Vince Dizon ang kumalat na impormasyon na sumabog na computer umano ang dahilan ng sunog sa Bureau of Research and Standards building sa Quezon City.  

Aniya, electrical short circuit sa kisame ng ikatlong palapag ng gusali ang pangunahing tinitingnang sanhi ng sunog, batay sa initial findings ng Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).
